==German==
===Etymology===
{{ety|de|:inh|gmh:stat<ety:inh<goh:stat>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|de|gmh|stat}}, from {{inh|de|goh|stat}}, from {{inh|de|gmw-pro|*stadi}}, from {{inh|de|gem-pro|*stadiz}}, from {{inh|de|ine-pro|*stéh₂tis}}. Cognate with {{cog|en|stead}}. {{doublet|de|Statt|Stätte}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|de|/ʃtat/}}
* {{audio|de|De-Stadt2.ogg|a=<<Germany>> (<<Berlin>>)}}
* {{homophones|de|statt}}
* {{rhymes|de|at|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{de-noun|f,^e|dim=^chen,^lein}}

# [[city]] {{gl|a large settlement}}
#* {{quote-book|de|year=1931|author=w:de:Gebhard Mehring|title=s:de:Schrift und Schrifttum|publisher=Silberburg-Verlag|page=13
|passage=Der Zerfall des Römerreiches raubte der '''Stadt''' Rom die alte Stellung als Mittelpunkt alles Geschehens.|t=The decay of the Roman empire robbed the '''city''' of Rome of the old position as the center of all that was happening.}}
# [[town]] {{gl|a settlement larger than a village}}
# {{lb|de|metonymy}} [[city center]] {{gl|a central business area of a city}}
# {{lb|de|metonymy}} city, town, [[town council]], [[city council]] {{gl|a governing body of people elected to oversee management of a municipality}}

====Usage notes====
* For some speakers, the plural has an irregular lengthening of the stem vowel. See {{m|de|Städte}}.
* Not to be confused with {{m|de|Staat}}.

====Declension====
{{de-ndecl|f,^e}}
